reason: The only Strassen wrapper measured lost all 10 paired runs (433–568 GFLOP/s versus controls of 776–1,092), so its variants rank below the lower-risk classical loop-control and panel experiments. Among Strassen changes, removing the output zero pass is a distinct, limited change; one allocation or one product buffer may save overhead, while explicit NEON may duplicate compiler vectorization. Transpose fusion rereads A 16 times and adds complex mapping work. Tail handling does not affect the fixed n=512 timing path. The seven products and recombination signs are algebraically valid: C11=P1+P4−P5+P7, C12=P3+P5, C21=P2+P4, C22=P1−P2+P3+P6. For row-major P=X@Y, the dense 256 helper requires [4]=Y, [10]=X, [16]=P; parent quadrants must be packed from stride 512 to stride 256. FP32 cancellation and scale-sensitive accuracy remain key correctness risks under tolerance 0.002. Rankings are recommendations, not performance findings.
